# Shared SAGE add-with-carry RNG test vectors (api-freeze-v1 F5 / S3).
#
# Consumed by BOTH OpenSage.Mathematics.Tests (SageRandom, the client/audio port) and
# OpenSage.SimCore.Tests (LogicRandom, the logic stream). Any divergence between the two
# implementations fails a test in whichever project drifted. Generated from a third,
# independent model of the generator, cross-checked against the pre-existing
# SageRandomTests expectations.
#
# Record types ('#' starts a comment, fields are whitespace separated):
#   RAW  <seed8> <index> <value8>          raw 32-bit draw #index for a stream seeded <seed8>
#   NEXT <seed8> <lo> <hi> <v0>..<vN>      Next(lo,hi) draws 0..N for a stream seeded <seed8>
#   FIX  <seed8> <loRaw16> <hiRaw16> <r0>..<rN>
#                                          NextFix64 raw Q31.32 results, draws 0..N
#                                          (SimCore only; SageRandom has no Fix64 surface)
